content: Claude API rate limits are org-level (RPM/ITPM/OTPM) and return 429 with retry-after; SDKs auto-retry transient/5xx/429 errors twice by default with exponential backoff. Best practice: validate input early, retry only transient errors, log request_id/latency/tokens/cost per call, and design graceful fallback (e.g. cached suggestion or 'try again later' UI) when the API is unavailable or slow.
